messages.subject: EVT-001 Technical Escalation: Block 6 Rock Refusal at 0.8m Depth & FDC-CIV-001 Issuance
messages.body: Technical escalation regarding EVT-001: Geotechnical investigation in Array Block 6 has encountered hard rock refusal at 0.8m depth, where tender engineering design assumed minimum embedment of 1.5m. Direct hydraulic ramming cannot achieve required embedment without structural buckling. Current civil design progress (WP-ENG-CIV) stands at 4.05% with QC acceptance at 3.8075%; PV field piling (WP-CON-CIV-PIL, scope 15,400 piles) has 0.0 delivered, 0.0 installed, and IFC status is False. In response, issuing Field Design Change FDC-CIV-001 specifying Down-The-Hole (DTH) pre-drilling and lean concrete/grout annular socketing to satisfy KMK 2.02.01-98 and KMK 2.01.03-19 while preserving tracker geometry without MOC impact. Piling in Block 6 is placed on HOLD. Commercial and schedule impacts are flagged to ARCHON for CLAIMS and KRONOS: expected piling productivity factor in rock is 0.25, constituting an Unforeseeable Physical Condition under FIDIC Sub-Clause 4.12. Formal notice under Sub-Clause 20.1 is recommended. As TERRA financial authority limit is ESCALATE, all cost and time impacts are escalated to ARCHON.

messages.subject: Site Directive: Piling Hold on Array Block 6 & Implementation of FDC-CIV-001
messages.body: Site operational directive for EVT-001: Enforce an immediate HOLD on all direct hydraulic ramming in Array Block 6 due to rock refusal encountered at 0.8m depth against the 1.5m tender design assumption. Driving piles against hard rock without pre-drilling is prohibited to prevent pile shaft buckling. Field Design Change FDC-CIV-001 is issued requiring DTH pre-drilling and annular grouting. Piling rigs shall be re-sequenced to non-rock array blocks to maintain progress on WP-CON-CIV-PIL (scope 15,400 piles, delivered 0.0, installed 0.0, QC accepted 0.0, IFC False). Production piling in Block 6 shall not commence until pre-drilling trial piles are installed, tested, and certified by PLUMBLINE.

messages.subject: Urgent Geotechnical Data Request: Block 6 Rock Strata Delineation & Mechanical Properties
messages.body: Following EVT-001 rock refusal at 0.8m depth in Array Block 6, TERRA requires certified geotechnical investigation data to finalize pile design calculations (HEL-ST-CAL-0010) and support FDC-CIV-001. Per TERRA authority limits, no civil IFC will be issued without certified geotechnical data. Please execute confirmatory boreholes on a staggered grid in Block 6 to map the rock interface, and provide laboratory test results including Unconfined Compressive Strength (UCS per GOST 21153.2-84 / ASTM D7012), Rock Quality Designation (RQD %), and chemical analysis for groundwater/soil sulfate aggressiveness to confirm annular grout mix design.

messages.subject: Pre-Construction Pile Load Test Acceptance Criteria - Array Block 6 (FDC-CIV-001)
messages.body: Specification of mandatory pre-construction pile load test criteria for Array Block 6 pre-drilled and grouted piles under FDC-CIV-001: Mandate 3 test piles (1 No. Static Axial Compression per ASTM D1143 / KMK 2.02.01-98, 1 No. Axial Tension/Pull-out per ASTM D3689, and 1 No. Lateral Load Test per ASTM D3966). Acceptance criteria: pull-out capacity must achieve design aerodynamic uplift load with safety factor >= 1.5; lateral deflection must not exceed 6mm at design working load; zero grout shear failure at pile-rock interface. Hold points are mandatory; no production piling in Block 6 shall be accepted without co-signed test records.

messages.subject: EVT-001 Technical Escalation: Block 6 Rock Refusal at 0.8m & Design Release Hold Recommendation
messages.body: Confirmatory geotechnical boreholes in Array Block 6 have encountered hard rock layer refusal at 0.8m depth, directly contradicting the tender engineering design assumption of refusal at 1.5m. Piling in Block 6 is blocked; standard hydraulic ramming cannot achieve the required design embedment depth for WP-CON-CIV-PIL (scope 15,400 piles). In accordance with MERIDIAN authority limits, I recommend an immediate halt on civil IFC design release for Array Block 6 (WP-ENG-CIV, current progress 4.05%) until supplementary rock delineation is complete and foundation redesign parameters are established. This discrepancy constitutes a potential FIDIC Sub-Clause 4.12 Unforeseeable Physical Conditions event and is flagged for contractual notification. Directing a supplementary rotary core drilling campaign (6 boreholes to 3.0m) to map continuous rock strata.

messages.subject: Urgent Geotechnical Data Request: Block 6 Confirmatory Stratigraphy & Rock Refusal Response
messages.body: In response to TERRA RFI (HEL-ENG-ENG-RFI-0003) regarding Array Block 6 under EVT-001: Geotechnical investigations confirm hard rock layer refusal at 0.8m depth versus tender design assumption of 1.5m. Overburden consists of 0.0m to 0.8m loose-to-medium silty sand/gravel overlying competent rock, causing immediate refusal for standard hydraulic ramming rigs. Foundation design response (pre-drilling with rock socketing, micro-piling, or concrete spread plinths) remains strictly TERRA remit. To support engineering evaluation, MERIDIAN is executing supplementary rotary core drilling (6 boreholes to 3.0m depth) to deliver core recovery, RQD, and UCS test data within 48 hours.

messages.subject: FIDIC Sub-Clause 4.12 Technical Evidence: Ground Discrepancy Log for Array Block 6 (EVT-001)
messages.body: Transmitting factual geotechnical evidence for formal notice under FIDIC Yellow Book Sub-Clause 4.12 (Unforeseeable Physical Conditions). Baseline tender engineering design assumed geotechnical rock refusal at 1.5m depth across Array Block 6. Confirmatory testing establishes hard rock refusal at 0.8m depth, preventing standard pile ramming for WP-CON-CIV-PIL (scope 15,400 piles). Physical conditions could not reasonably have been foreseen by an experienced contractor at tender stage based on employer-provided tender data. Technical deviation logged in the 4.12 Evidence Register to substantiate Contractor notice and reservation of rights under Sub-Clause 20.1.

messages.subject: FIDIC Sub-Clause 4.12 / 20.1 Notice of Claim: Unforeseeable Physical Conditions at Array Block 6 (EVT-001)
messages.body: Pursuant to FIDIC Yellow Book 1999 Sub-Clause 1.3 [Communications], Sub-Clause 4.12 [Unforeseeable Physical Conditions], and Sub-Clause 20.1 [Contractor's Claims], EPC Global Solutions hereby gives formal notice of an Unforeseeable Physical Condition encountered in Array Block 6. Confirmatory geotechnical investigation boreholes have encountered an impermeable competent bedrock refusal horizon at 0.8m depth, whereas tender engineering design and Employer baseline documentation assumed minimum pile embedment refusal at 1.5m. Hydraulic ramming cannot achieve design embedment without structural refusal. This condition was not foreseeable by an experienced contractor at the Base Date. Notice is hereby formally given of Contractor's intention to claim additional Cost under Sub-Clause 4.12 and Sub-Clause 13.3, and Extension of Time (EOT) under Sub-Clause 8.4(b) and Sub-Clause 4.12. Contemporary site records are being maintained pursuant to Sub-Clause 20.1, and detailed particulars will be submitted within the statutory 42-day period.
